The decision rules treat files under `Examples/` or `SampleApp/` as sample-app mirrors regardless of the flag value, and the restraint-marker rule says any such record dominates toward no-action.

Lifting it into shared code would couple the sample app to production infrastructure, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against.
